insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options (vary by plan): 5/7.5/10/15/20/25/50/75/100/200 Lakhs (as per Annexure C plan chart)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: Room rent limit shall be At Actuals unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule.
great.explanation: Room rent is payable at actuals unless the Policy Schedule specifies a limit. This reduces the chance of room-rent linked out-of-pocket costs and gives flexibility to choose a room.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: The Secure Benefit will be applicable only after exhaustion of Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: Secure Benefit becomes available only after your Base Sum Insured is fully used up. This provides extra insurer-funded coverage for large or multiple claims in the same policy year.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: The restored Sum Insured can be used even for the same illness for which an admissible claim has been paid during the Policy Year and also for any other Illness covered under the Policy.
great.explanation: Restored Sum Insured can be used even for the same illness within the same policy year. This is stronger than many restores that work only for unrelated illnesses.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 60 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule, immediately prior to the date of admission.
great.explanation: Pre-hospitalization medical expenses are covered up to 60 days before admission (unless the Policy Schedule says otherwise). This helps pay for diagnostics and consultations leading up to hospitalization.

great.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: Such expenses shall be indemnified if the same were incurred upto 180 days unless otherwise specified in the Policy Schedule, immediately post the date of discharge from the Hospital.
great.explanation: Post-hospitalization medical expenses are covered up to 180 days after discharge (unless the Policy Schedule says otherwise). This supports follow-up treatment and medicines during recovery.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy with us.
good.explanation: Listed specific conditions/surgeries are not covered until 24 months of continuous coverage are completed. This is a common market-standard waiting period for named ailments.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify expenses incurred by the Insured Person during the Policy Year towards Ambulance transportation in an airplane or helicopter for Emergency Care...
good.explanation: Air ambulance transportation for emergency care is covered as per the policy terms. This can be valuable in critical situations where rapid transfer is medically necessary.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident, provided the same are covered.
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered for the first 30 days from policy start, while accidents are covered (if otherwise covered). This is a standard initial waiting period in retail health insurance.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months (Unless specified otherwise in the Policy Schedule) of continuous coverage...
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered only after 36 months of continuous coverage (unless the Policy Schedule states otherwise). This is within the typical 24 year range seen in many plans.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred during the Policy Year on Domiciliary Hospitalization...
good.explanation: Medical expenses for domiciliary hospitalization (treatment at home when hospitalization is not possible) are covered. This helps in situations where home-based treatment is medically required.

good.name: AYUSH Treatment
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred by the Insured Person only for Inpatient Care under Ayurveda, Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy systems of medicines... up to the Sub-limit specified against this Cover in the Policy Schedule
good.explanation: Inpatient AYUSH treatment is covered up to the sub-limit mentioned in the Policy Schedule. This provides alternative medicine coverage but with a cap.

good.name: Optional Add-ons
good.quote: my: Optima Secure offers following Add on Covers: 1. my: health Critical Illness Add On... 2. my: health Hospital Cash Benefit Add On... 4. Unlimited Restore (Add on)... 5. Optima Wellbeing (Add on)...
good.explanation: Multiple add-ons are available such as Critical Illness, Hospital Cash, Unlimited Restore and Wellbeing/OPD-related benefits. This lets you enhance coverage by paying extra premium for chosen riders.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Annexure B- Items for which Coverage is not available in the Policy (Non-Medical Expenses)... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ...
bad.reference: Annexure B, Pages 49-50; Section B.2.3 Protect Benefit, Page 15-16
bad.explanation: Common non-medical/consumable items (e.g., gloves, masks) are not covered under the base policy as per the non-payable items list. This can increase out-of-pocket costs unless a separate add-on is purchased to cover them.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-Payment means a cost sharing requirement under a health insurance policy that provides that the policyholder/insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claims amount.
bad.explanation: Only a glossary definition of co-payment is provided and no applied co-pay clause is shown here. No co-pay should be charged unless the Policy Schedule or an applied clause specifically imposes it.

unclear.name: NCB
unclear.quote: This Cover will be applied irrespective of number of claims made under the expiring Policy.
unclear.explanation: The wording says the cover applies irrespective of the number of claims in the expiring policy, but it does not clearly state whether it is a cumulative bonus or a different benefit. The actual impact on Sum Insured at renewal needs confirmation from the plan/schedule.

unclear.name: NCB
unclear.quote: 1.8 Cumulative Bonus ... Optima Secure: Not Covered
unclear.explanation: The plan chart states Cumulative Bonus is not covered under Optima Secure. This conflicts with the other clause mentioning a cover applying irrespective of claims, so the renewal increase benefit needs clarification.
